# Organization subscription
{: .no_toc }

An organization's Standard subscription and which members it covers.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `BIL-02` |
| **Route** | `/orgs/:orgId/subscription` · deep link `substratal://orgs/:orgId/subscription` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Plan card | card | OrganizationSubscription.plan + Subscription.status, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end |  | .card box |
| Billed users | key-value | quantity.current (live), quantity.last_synced + last_synced_at, unit_amount | "31 covered · 30 billed on next invoice (synced daily)" | AdwActionRow subtitle |
| Who's covered | radio-group | member_scope all_members \ | allowlist \ | GtkCheckButton group |
| Members | member-picker | member_overrides (active members only) | visible for allowlist/denylist | AdwDialog with GtkSearchEntry list |
| Subscribe the organization | primary-button | → BIL-03 org checkout (member_scope optional) | org_admin; when no subscription or not in force | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |
| Manage billing | button | → BIL-03 org portal | org_admin or billing.manage | GtkButton |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Save coverage | `PATCH /organizations/{id}/subscription {member_scope, member_overrides} (If-Match)` | effective immediately (access.granted/revoked); billed from next daily sync. 422 member_override_not_a_member → mark rows. 404 subscription_not_found → show Subscribe. |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES
- Members gained or lost take effect at once; say so before saving.

## For developers

Loads: `GET /organizations/{id}/subscription` · `GET /organizations/{id}/members (for the member picker)`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
